attrs._setText: Explore Careers, set your goals and claim rewards
Take on rewarding jobs from capsuleer corporations. Earn rewards, gain experience, connect with others, and unlock new opportunities.

attrs._hint: Explorers can use probes to scan Cosmic Signatures which may contain hackable containers with items inside, resources like gas clouds or ore, wormholes to distant star systems, or combat sites.

Soldiers of Fortune focus on combat with other Capsuleers, participating in Faction Warfare, electronic warfare, hunting in covert ships, joining fleets to provide support or to fight in huge battles.
Industrialists can participate in mining ore, reprocessing minerals, salvaging destroyed ships, manufacturing items, market trading or transporting goods across New Eden.
Enforcers can complete missions for Agents, hunt pirates for bounties, participate in Incursions or dive into Abyssal Deadspace in search of loot.
